The Saxby CosmosEco V3 is a fixed, fire-rated LED recessed downlight, offering reliable and energy-efficient lighting. Featuring an integrated LED, it provides a warm white 3000K light output suitable for a variety of indoor environments, including Zone 1 bathroom installations and commercial premises, thanks to its IP65 rating. Installation is straightforward with a 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block and a 57mm cut-out diameter. The dimmable function allows for flexible lighting control, while the durable steel body and 50,000-hour lifespan ensure a long-lasting, low-maintenance lighting solution for electricians and builders.
